Name: EZ Legendary Fish Content Patcher Edition
Author: MissCoriel
TagLine: Don't want to cheat with  most fish.. but those Legendaries getting you down?!  Install this and all Legendaries will be easy to catch, without taking out the fishing minigame!!!
Description:
If you like to relax and go fishing, but can't catch those pesky Legendary Fish.. then look no further.

There are many ways to make the fish game instawin every fish, removing the general challenge and taking away a bit of the game.
This mod adjusts the difficulty of all the Legendary Fish to be simple to catch, though you still will have to go through the fishing game.
This means that general fishing is unchanged, and you don't instawin against legendary fish and thus still got to put a small amount of effort.

I added a more Challenging version that ups the difficulty but still easier than their default difficulty.

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)

3.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

4.  Run the game using SMAPI.

Downloads.Description: This will make all Legendary Fish easy to catch.
